role: Controlled benign/background source for Track-L training, validation, and calibration after the separate acquisition and training gates.

authorization_and_isolation.network: isolated controlled network; no production credentials, endpoints, or formal-evaluation hosts
authorization_and_isolation.formal_exclusion: No FA1B2de playbook/action, copied formal sequence, formal label, outcome, or benchmark host/run may be used.

collection_matrix.group_construction: Exactly one complete 900-second collection run per host/workload-family pair; 4 hosts × 6 families = 24 whole run groups. Each group has a fresh run_id and is never split by event.
collection_matrix.seed_assignment: Sort host IDs then workload-family IDs by UTF-8 bytes; assign fixed_generation_seeds in ordinal order. A seed is never reused across two run_ids or any validation/calibration generator.

coverage_and_quality.collector: auditd or an explicitly versioned equivalent with process, file, and socket/provenance visibility
coverage_and_quality.coverage_interpretation: If a workload cannot legitimately produce one category, record an explicit zero and the collector's unknown/loss counter; never silently omit the category. Across the 24 groups, every required behavior in every family must be observed at least once.

loss_threshold.action_on_failure: Quarantine the complete run group and block acquisition/training release; do not repair by interpolation or relabeling.

label_and_split_boundary.label: benign_by_controlled_generation
label_and_split_boundary.label_provenance: generator configuration and run manifest only
label_and_split_boundary.encoder_input: Labels, workload-family IDs, host IDs, run IDs, seed values, and partition IDs are not encoder features.
label_and_split_boundary.assignment: Use PROVX_R5_TRAIN_VALIDATION_SPLIT_CONTRACT.json after the immutable run manifest is created; no event-level split or post-hoc reassignment.
label_and_split_boundary.stage_a_boundary: If the run is designated reserved Stage A smoke data, it is excluded from this Stage-B corpus even if its events are benign.

hash_chain.canonicalization: UTF-8 canonical JSON with sorted keys and compact separators; records sorted by canonical source_record_id/timestamp key; newline-delimited raw and normalized streams.

steps.name: normalized
steps.digest: normalized_sha256 = SHA-256(canonical normalized record stream || raw_sha256)

steps.name: feature
steps.digest: feature_sha256 = SHA-256(canonical feature envelope {graph_sha256, encoder_id, encoder_sha256, x_dtype, x_shape, x_bytes_sha256, edge_index_dtype, edge_index_shape, edge_index_bytes_sha256})

hash_chain.verification: Recompute all four links from the immutable manifest before any group is admitted; any mismatch is a hard stop.

run_manifest_required: split contract ID and assigned partition after hashing
stop_conditions: any seed, host, or run identity overlaps formal FA1B2de material
collector loss > 1%, invalid records > 2%, timestamp errors, or nonfinite tensors
required coverage is absent without explicit zero/unknown counters
hash chain cannot be reproduced byte-for-byte
the corpus is used before the separate acquisition and training approvals
